assertions: The response routes the general Circos composition/legend/export task to the circular-composition sub-skill.
The response constructs Circos with a tuple range for sector B and explains the tuple endpoints are data coordinates (x in 100..130), matching the api-reference coordinate model.
The response uses get_group_sectors_deg_lim(["A","B"]) to place a group band rect, matching the api-reference/workflows group band recipe.
The response adds a directed link with x endpoints in each sector's own range, e.g. circos.link(("A",2,7),("B",120,110),direction=1).
The response calls fig = circos.plotfig(), then circos.ax.legend(...), then fig.savefig(...), and explains that circos.savefig() does not preserve post-render legend edits.
The response does not claim circos.ax is available before plotfig(), consistent with the documented ValueError behavior.
The response does not route track-local drawing to this sub-skill as if it owned track data.
